_README: PROVISIONAL, UNREVIEWED draft building-footprint annotations. Vertices are (col,row) pixel coordinates in each 800x800 native-resolution (0.05 m) window crop defined in windows.json, origin = window top-left. Traced visually by an AI assistant (Claude) from the raw orthophoto crops with a 2.5 m grid; no model prediction layer was shown while tracing. Outlines are roof outlines (what is visible from above), approximated to ~0.25-0.5 m. confidence: high = clearly a roofed building; medium = roof clear but extent/separation uncertain; low = may not be a building or may be roofless. Buildings crossing a window edge are clipped at the edge. Must be reviewed/corrected by a human before any metric is computed.
